description.zh: 查询范围，录制任务开始时间闭区间，单位：ms。
description.en: The query range specifies the start time of the recording task. It is defined as a closed interval and measured in milliseconds (ms).

description.zh: 查询范围，录制任务开始时间开区间，单位：ms。如果不传，默认查询3天内，最长查询过去一年的录制文件。
description.en: Query range start time (open interval) for recording tasks, in milliseconds. If not specified, defaults to the past 3 days. You can query recordings up to one year old.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The QPS limit for this API is 10 requests per second per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your service. Call this API only when necessary.
